system.description:
You can manipulate particles of gold dust, dense and heavy. While your Dust Veil is active, once per turn, As a Bonus action you release a wave of heavy weighted gold particles in a 20-Foot Cone originating from you, forcing all creatures in range of your choice to make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled in place until the end of their turns on a failure.

Potency I: Once per turn, When a creature fails a saving throw against a Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast, they become Heavy until the beginning of your next turn.

Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a wave, it increases in size to a 40-Foot Cone, and creatures who fail their saving throw also become Heavy and Slowed until the end of their following turns.
